policy_call_ms_note: median over ALL select_action calls, most of which are queue hits rather than a forward pass
achieved_control_hz_note: 1000 / (median sim ms + median policy-call ms): a TYPICAL step, blind to the forward-pass stalls; see wall_control_hz
wall_control_hz_note: control steps / wall time of the policy-acting loop, summed over episodes (settle steps and env construction excluded)
forward_detect: a select_action call > 10 ms is a forward pass; else a queue hit
resolution_note: 100 episodes resolves a policy that is BROKEN, not a few-percent difference in success rate
